name: Steve
author: laozhengzaici
variant_note: Classic Minecraft Steve skin rendered on a six-cuboid model, with custom rigid-limb animations and 16 stationary look directions for Codex v2. Model, animation and Codex adaptation by laozhengzaici.
source_notes: Final sprites directly reuse pixels from the official classic Steve skin supplied by the submitter. Original character and skin artwork: Mojang/Microsoft. The supplied all-faces crops are texture inputs, not independent pet artwork. laozhengzaici is credited for the model, animation and Codex adaptation, not for the original skin. Frames are rendered using nearest-texel texture sampling, face lighting, native alpha and supersampled edge coverage; adjacent skin texels are adapted for blinking. No AI-generated sprite pixels are used in the final sheet.
usage_notes: 仅限非商业使用。Non-commercial use only. Original Minecraft character and skin rights remain with Mojang/Microsoft; this adaptation does not claim ownership of or relicense the original artwork.
description: Classic Minecraft Steve as a block-model Codex v2 pet, with nine animation states and sixteen stationary look directions.
